captions.detailed: This 3D model features a dark grey mast-and-outrigger dual rotary assembly resting on a wide, heavy circular base. A central vertical cylindrical mast rises from the base, supporting two collar blocks stacked vertically. Each collar block carries a light grey horizontal arm of a different length, terminating in a small cylindrical tip. The two unequal branch arms rotate independently around the central vertical axis of the mast.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a mast-and-outrigger rotary head assembly with a heavy circular base and a vertical mast. Mount two separate, stacked collar blocks on the mast, each supporting a light-grey horizontal arm of unequal length (one long and one short). Design the assembly so that each branch arm can independently rotate 360 degrees around the vertical axis of the mast.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a 'base' link, which consists of a wide cylinder for the foot and a tall, thin cylinder for the vertical mast. It then defines two separate collar-and-arm links: 'arm_lower' (the longer outrigger) and 'arm_upper' (the shorter outrigger). Each arm geometry is built by extruding a combination of rectangular blocks and circular ends, attached to a collar cylinder. Finally, two continuous joints are defined with their rotation axes aligned vertically along the central mast, allowing independent revolute articulation of the lower and upper arms.
